notes.title: Lots of Improvements
notes.content:
Improvements to production values and gameplay. Get grabbing!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31649762/2320c6108877dbccee370cc3c11c79488916ba16.png[/img]

New character models
Improved controls
Plants
A few redesigned levels
Revised level times
Redesigned hub world
GUI elements
New primary music theme
More animated instructions
